evidenceLayout: tmp/mod004/<planId>/ holds each plan's full command logs. Each plan's Progress Log records every command, its exit status and its log path. Retries go under tmp/mod004/<planId>/attempt-<n>/. tmp/ is gitignored and must stay untracked. A missing or truncated log is not a pass.

executionModel.commitOwner: The orchestrator commits after the run. Workers never commit, stash, checkout, reset, branch, push or merge.
executionModel.retryPolicy: Each wave has one plan, so no concurrent cargo contention is expected. If cargo reports a lock, wait about 60 s and retry, up to 10 times, then record a blocker in the plan's Progress Log.
executionModel.editProtocol: Before each edit, re-read the file and record its sha256 and an intent snapshot in the Progress Log. If the file drifted, stop and report. After editing, record the post-edit sha256. Never edit outside writePaths.
executionModel.serialReconciliation: MOD004-40 owns crate-wide cargo fmt, the parent-plan, README and design status updates, the Status lines of MOD004-20/21/22/30/40, and any cross-plan repair.

dependencyNote: dependsOn lists only plans in this manifest. MOD004-00/10/11/12 (85a300a) and MOD004-20/21/22 (b6fa077) are accepted committed dependencies recorded in acceptedDependsOn and acceptedDependencies; they are not dispatched.

reviewContext.userProblem: Nine prelude templates instantiate one engine twice to recover main and aux although both are simultaneous outputs of one engine state; MOD-004 also lacks native vs browser, orbit and rate/block regression coverage for multi-output and stereo graphs, and its plans are not closed out.
constraints: Follow the committed MOD-004 design and the owner decisions resolved 2026-09-29; do not reopen them.
MOD004-30 changes no runtime, codec, lowering or checker code.
Never re-bless render digests; bless may be used only to obtain the nine new graph lines.
The audio callback stays allocation-free and bounded; native and wasm32 behave identically.
Every touched Rust file stays under 1000 lines, split per .agents/skills/rust-coding-standards/.
Write only under src/, design-docs/, impl-plans/ and tmp/. Workers do not change git state; the orchestrator commits without Co-Authored-By or tool attribution and does not push.
cargo runs with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true; nextest with NEXTEST_STATUS_LEVEL=fail NEXTEST_FAILURE_OUTPUT=immediate-final NEXTEST_HIDE_PROGRESS_BAR=1.
Never weaken an audio assertion; cross-plan repairs in MOD004-40 are serial and justified in its Progress Log.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Only the nine templates whose main and aux are simultaneous outputs of one engine state migrate (design migration eligibility and exclusion table).
The bound node keeps the main instance's arguments verbatim including mode: 0 or chain-channel: 0, so output 0 is the old main and output 1 the old aux (design migration paragraph).
filter-voice merges its two identical va-source nodes; va_filter::source reads no seed, and the bitwise test is the proof (design Implementation status).
Legacy aux-out voices use unity-center balance pan: bit-identical at center, off-center follows balance_gains (owner decision).
intentionalTradeoffs: Old duplicate-node forms stay valid; the 27 excluded templates keep their form and sound.
If block-partition invariance also fails for the legacy two-node form, the finding is recorded rather than fixed in engine code.
reviewContext.sourceSyntaxNote: In .vact source, ( ) is rejected by the lexer (paren-form); use let p {...} and {p :main}/{p :aux}. Never write (p :main) in templates.vact or test strings.
requiredOutcomes: MOD004-30: exactly nine templates migrate, each bit-identical to its old form in main and aux at two control settings; only their nine graph lines change in golden_digests.txt.

MOD004-40: native and browser shape and render parity, channel independence, pan/balance, orbit, allocation probes, rate/block invariance, the full acceptance command set, and the MOD-004A..F closeout.
nonGoals: Migrating any template beyond the nine.
Runtime, codec, lowering, checker or kernel changes in MOD004-30.
Edits to src/dsp/ported/*.rs manifests or src/ns/insts.rs.
supportedEdgeCases: filter-voice merges two identical va-source nodes into one bound node; bitwise equivalence is the proof.
A shadows-prelude diagnostic on the binding name p falls back to the name pair.
Templates with aux render only at center in golden digests, so no pan02 render line changes.
Legacy aux-out voices off-center follow unity-center balance_gains; at center they stay bit-identical.
Rate/block invariance at 44100/48000/96000 Hz with blocks 64, 256 and the non-power-of-two 97 (MAX_BLOCK is 8192).
Native vs browser (wasm32 codec round-trip) shape and render parity for multi-output and stereo graphs.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: The 27 excluded duplicate-node templates (for example phase-pair-voice, resonator-voice) keep two kernel nodes.
Legacy graph-payload decoding across revisions (same-revision native/browser peers only).
Dot-syntax or grammar changes for output selection; (p :main) paren form is rejected by the lexer in .vact source.
Engine fixes when the legacy two-node form is itself block-partition dependent; the finding is recorded only.
residualRisks: MOD004-40 plan text command 8 (git diff --name-only cf2ea37 | xargs wc -l) fails on deleted files; the manifest while-read/awk form is authoritative.
Nine-template bitwise equivalence and block-partition invariance are proven only when the planned tests run.
